author: Adam Schefter
text: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts was evaluated for a concussion and cleared to return.

author: Ian Rapoport
text:
Jets star RB Breece Hall, who suffered a quad injury in Sunday’s game, is considered week-to-week, per me and Adam Schefter. 

Hall received some good news after the MRI, as the injury isn’t as significant as feared.

author: Adam Schefter
text: #Buccaneers HC Todd Bowles said QB Baker Mayfield will miss three weeks due to his thumb injury.

author: Ian Rapoport
text:
🚨 🚨 🚨 

The Giants are trading for Vikings former first-round QB JJ McCarthy, per me, Adam Schefter and Mike Garafolo.

With Jaxson Dart out for the regular season, NYG acquires McCarthy to help solidify their room. An intriguing add.

author: Adam Schefter
text: Trade: Vikings are sending J.J. McCarthy to the New York Giants, sources tell me, @rapsheet and @mikegarafolo.

author: Ian Rapoport
text:
Dolphins star RB De’Von Achane suffered a torn ACL, sources tell me and Adam Schefter, and he’s out for the season.

In an already trying season for Miami, the team loses Achane.

author: Adam Schefter
text: Dolphins RB De’Von Achane suffered a torn ACL during Sunday’s loss to the Chiefs and will be out for the season, sources tell @rapsheet and me.

author: Ian Rapoport
text:
Giants star pass-rusher Brian Burns is believed to have suffered a torn ACL, sources tell me and Adam Schefter.

Burns, who played Sunday through ankle pain, now has a major knee injury. A significant loss.

author: Adam Schefter
text: Giants standout pass rusher Brian Burns is believed to have torn his ACL during Sunday’s win over the Titans, sources tell @rapsheet and me. Burns entered Sunday’s game with an ankle injury, then hurt his knee.

author: Ian Rapoport
text: Bears QB Caleb Williams, dealing with a Grade 2 hamstring strain, was given a 3-4 week recovery timeline, sources tell me and Adam Schefter.

author: Adam Schefter
text: Chicago Bears quarterback Caleb Williams has a Grade 2 hamstring injury that doctors consider a three-to-four-week injury, league sources told me and @RapSheet.

author: Adam Schefter
text:
Source: With a high-ankle sprain, Broncos RB Jonah Coleman now will miss the next few games and be placed on short-term injured reserve today.

Coleman is expected back for the Broncos’ game against the Cardinals in late October.

author: Adam Schefter
text:
Bears officially have ruled out Caleb Williams for Monday night’s game vs. the Eagles.

Tyson Bagent is questionable.

author: Adam Schefter
text: Seahawks QB Sam Darnold is off the injury report for Sunday’s game at Washington and is good to go.

author: Adam Schefter
text: Puka Nacua will not practice and will be listed as doubtful for the game against the Broncos. Sean McVay believes that, barring a setback, Nacua could return next week vs. the Eagles.

author: Adam Schefter
text: Another round: Cowboys TE Jake Ferguson was fined $13,611 for what the NFL said was his “imitation of shotgunning a beer” Sunday vs. Washington that “constituted an offensive demonstration and could reasonably could be construed as being in poor taste.”

author: Adam Schefter
text: Five-time Pro-Bowl DE Nick Bosa pulled his calf during Thursday’s practice and now is expected to miss “a few weeks”, including Sunday’s game vs. the Cardinals, sources tell me and @RapSheet. The team is figuring out whether or not Bosa needs to be placed on injured reserve.

author: Ian Rapoport
text:
49ers Pro Bowl DE Nick Bosa suffered a calf injury in practice this week and is expected to miss a few weeks, per me and Adam Schefter. 

He's out this week against the #AZCardinals and TBD on whether he lands on IR.

author: Adam Schefter
text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels will not be placed on injured reserve, sources confirmed to @RapSheet and me. After imaging on his dislocated left elbow was evaluated and multiple specialists were consulted, the consensus is that Daniels now will be considered week-to-week. Both Daniels and the Commanders say they are aiming for him to return as soon as possible.

author: Ian Rapoport
text:
Commanders QB Jayden Daniels will not be placed on IR, per me and Adam Schefter. 

After imaging was evaluated and multiple specialists were consulted this week, the consensus is Daniels is week-to-week and both WAS and Daniels are aiming for him to return as soon as possible.

author: Adam Schefter
text: For the second straight day, Rams WR Puka Nacua did not practice due to what the team is calling a hip injury.

author: Adam Schefter
text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart is out for the “regular season,” Giants HC John Harbaugh confirmed today. Harbaugh is holding out hope that Dart can return for the postseason if the Giants can advance there.

author: Adam Schefter
text: More Giants woes: OLB Brian Burns, who is dealing with an ankle injury and was not spotted on the practice field earlier today, is not expected to need surgery but is likely to miss some time, per source.

author: Adam Schefter
text: Colts HC Shane Steichen told reporters that WR Alec Pierce is being placed on injured reserve due to his heel injury. Pierce now will miss a minimum of four games.
